name: Centennial
seo_title: Centennial Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events, 3 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Centennial, CO: the Colorado Christmas Bazaar at Centennial Promenade, free Santa photos, Cookies and Stories and winter crafts.
lede: Centennial's Christmas happens indoors at Centennial Promenade, where a four weekend bazaar adds free Santa photos, story times and an indoor petting zoo.
celebrates: Centennial's season runs through Centennial Promenade, at 9555 E. County Line Road, where Colorado Markets holds the Colorado Christmas Bazaar on four weekends from November 28 to December 20. Colorado.com lists free admission and free parking. Families can get free Santa photos from 11 am to 4 pm every day, hear a local author read a holiday book with Santa at 3 pm on Saturdays while kids get a cookie, visit an indoor petting zoo, write letters to Santa and join the Squishmas Treasure Hunt. A free Winter Crafts session on December 1 rounds out the list for younger children.
lastyear: The Colorado Christmas Bazaar is a recurring holiday market, and the Colorado.com listing says it is back at Centennial Promenade for four weekends in 2026. The host's page bills the bazaar as seen on 9NEWS and describes it as one of the most anticipated events of the year, with vendors who sell out fast. We did not find a published 2025 attendance recap, so check Colorado Markets for current details.
facts: Colorado Markets says the bazaar brings together hundreds of unique, handmade and boutique gift options from local artisans, makers and small businesses. The host tags it as an indoor holiday experience, which helps on a cold weekend. Vendors apply by weekend, with booth prices starting at $369 and a 20 percent discount for booking all four weekends. Colorado Markets also sends text alerts about events, according to the host's listing.
trains: Centennial has no Christmas train of its own, but RTD's E and R light rail lines both stop at Dry Creek Station, Arapahoe at Village Center Station and Orchard Station, and the E line runs from Union Station to RidgeGate Parkway Station. For steam and rail history, see the Forney Museum of Transportation in Denver, home of Union Pacific Big Boy No. 4005, and the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden.

kidfact: At the Colorado Christmas Bazaar, an indoor petting zoo and free Santa photos are both on the list, so kids can meet animals and Santa under one roof.
faq: Where is the Colorado Christmas Bazaar?

The bazaar is at Centennial Promenade, 9555 E. County Line Road, Centennial, CO 80112. The host lists Saturdays from 10 am to 6 pm and Sundays from 11 am to 6 pm on four weekends, November 28 and 29, December 5 and 6, December 12 and 13 and December 19 and 20, 2026.
Is the Colorado Christmas Bazaar free?

General admission is free, according to the host and Colorado.com, which also lists free parking. Some extras need a reservation, such as the Squishmas Treasure Hunt, which asks for one ticket per child and an adult general admission ticket for the same date, and the registered cookie at Cookies and Stories with Santa.
When can kids see Santa in Centennial?

The bazaar lists free Santa photos from 11 am to 4 pm every day it is open. On Saturdays at 3 pm a local author reads a holiday book with Santa, and every registered child gets a cookie. Kids must come with a parent or guardian, and the host asks families to register ahead.
Is there anything besides shopping for kids?

Yes. The host lists an indoor petting zoo, letters to Santa, the Squishmas Treasure Hunt and a special activity on each weekend, such as a kids choir on December 5 or a cookie decorating class on December 6. The Winter Crafts session on December 1 is also free.
Is there a train ride near Centennial?

RTD's E and R light rail lines stop at Dry Creek, Arapahoe at Village Center and Orchard stations. For a Christmas train ride, the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden lists holiday trains, and the Forney Museum in Denver shows Union Pacific Big Boy No. 4005. Both have pages on our site.
